cat > /tmp/poll_precompute.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Poll all 4 servers, exit when all train_crm processes are done
SSH_OPTS="-o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"
declare -A SERVERS=( [bjb1-32546]=bjb1-32546 [bjb2-40593]=autodl-4090 [bjb2-28827]=bjb2-28827 [bjb1-18228]=autodl-4090x4 )

iter=0
while true; do
    iter=$((iter+1))
    ts=$(date +%H:%M:%S)
    total=0
    statuses=""
    for name in bjb1-32546 bjb2-40593 bjb2-28827 bjb1-18228; do
        host=${SERVERS[$name]}
        n=$(ssh $SSH_OPTS $host "ps aux | grep train_crm | grep -v grep | wc -l" 2>/dev/null)
        n=${n:-ERR}
        statuses="$statuses $name=$n"
        if [ "$n" != "ERR" ] && [ "$n" != "0" ]; then
            total=$((total + n))
        fi
    done
    echo "[$ts iter=$iter] total=$total$statuses"
    if [ "$total" = "0" ]; then
        echo "ALL_DONE"
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 120
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/poll_precompute.sh
echo "script ready"
